Method of Attack: Yank the existing 'clean' component from the RubyGems repo and replace the clean component with a malicious component
Attack Vector: Obtain rights to publish, yank the existing clean component, replace with malicious component, force users to upgrade
Indicators of Compromise: A version of the library removed and a new one released immediately after, modifications done on RubyGems but not on GitHub where the source code is managed
